name: s3-ziro
description: S3-compatible object storage (Garage) for backups, snapshots and apps; local-only by default

settings.name: bind
settings.description: S3 API address; 0.0.0.0 exposes it (the host firewall still applies)

files.content:
# Managed by `ziroctl plugin enable s3-ziro`. Single node, RPC and admin API on loopback only.
metadata_dir = "/var/lib/garage/meta"
data_dir = "/var/lib/garage/data"
db_engine = "sqlite"
metadata_fsync = true
replication_factor = 1
compression_level = 1
rpc_bind_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_public_addr = "127.0.0.1:3901"
rpc_secret = "{{secret.rpc_secret}}"

[s3_api]
s3_region = "garage"
api_bind_addr = "{{setting.bind}}:{{setting.port}}"
root_domain = ".s3.ziro"

[admin]
api_bind_addr = "127.0.0.1:3903"
admin_token = "{{secret.admin_token}}"
metrics_token = "{{secret.metrics_token}}"
